referenceFunction.generalComment: The functional unit represents 1 m2 of a 6-layer FR-4 PWB, HAL (Sn-Pb) surface finished, with soldermask, for surface mount applications, without mounted components. It is designed to be used in ICT applications. Process data are taken from environmental reports of 3 German PWB producers, plus from literature. The described PWB has a square weight of 3.26 kg/m2.; UUID: 59194bfe-9472-3333-89dc-9ab4d75490f8
referenceFunction.includedProcesses: The module covers the assembly of a PWB prepared for surface mounting of components. In this dataset (raw) materials, infrastructure, energy consumption, emissions to air and water and waste amounts from the production of 1 m2 of board are taken into account. Not included into this dataset is the mounting of the PWB.

technology.text: Dataset comprises the following steps of PWB production: substrate preparation, imaging, exposure, etching, sandwiching, activation and accelaration steps as well as copper plating, cleaning, oxidification, dry vacuum lamination, micro etching, hot air levelling.
